# SSH-005: MaxAuthTries is low

- **Group:** SSH
- **Severity when it fails:** low
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check may report `unknown`; it never reports a pass it could not verify.

## Why it matters

MaxAuthTries caps the authentication attempts per connection. The default of 6 gives a guesser more tries per connection, and log lines arrive later for fail2ban or CrowdSec to act on.

## Verify by hand

```sh
sudo sshd -T | grep -i '^maxauthtries'
```

## How to fix it

Set MaxAuthTries 3.

## What a fix can break

Clients that offer many keys from an agent may hit the limit before the right key; point them at one key with IdentitiesOnly.

Run `stackward explain SSH-005` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
